about: Role combinations: which roles one person may safely hold together, and which they may not. The project-tailoring:role-mapping skill applies these rules when it proposes who holds each role. Owned by Robert Peledie. Status: draft. severity: "unsafe" means the mapping must not propose it; "caution" means it may, with the reason stated.

rule.reason: The person who builds a change should not also sign off its testing.
Acceptable on small projects, but the security design then needs an independent review.
Normal at SMB scale; arrange a second-pair-of-eyes review from someone outside the delivery.
Workable with automated pipelines; without them, the same person both changes and promotes code.
Migration reconciliation needs to be checked by someone other than the person who loaded the data.
Removes the escalation route; make sure a steering group still exists.
The DPO's advice should remain independent of the people designing the controls.
Common at SMB scale, but the analyst may document how things are done today rather than challenge them.
